title: An interval problem of Erdős for four and five primes: code and data
description: Programs and recorded output accompanying the paper 'An interval problem of Erdős for four and five primes' by D. Bhattacharjee, P. Mandal and U. Bhattacharya. They include the certified search (exact Farkas certificates and a parity test) behind h(5) = 2, the finite checks for small primes, and the verification of the explicit good intervals quoted in the paper.
